terms_intro: OnTheBridge Watchlist (“this website”) is a free service for saving what you want to watch or listen to. By using it, you agree to the terms below.
terms_purpose_text: This website is a “watchlist” for the movies, series, documentaries and music you like, so you can follow up on them later, and it shows which provider or platform offers each title. It does not stream or play full movies, series, documentaries or songs — you watch or listen on the provider’s own platform with your own account.
terms_not_owner_title: We do not own the content
terms_not_owner_text: Titles, synopses, posters, album art, trailers and song previews belong to their creators and data providers. We show them only to help you decide and follow the title to its source. Trailers play through YouTube and song previews (30 seconds at most) stream directly from Apple; we do not store these files.
terms_source_tmdb: Movie, series and documentary data (titles, synopses, posters, ratings, cast) comes from TMDB (The Movie Database).
terms_source_justwatch: Where each title can be watched in Thailand comes from JustWatch (via TMDB).
terms_source_apple: Music data, top-song charts, album art and 30-second previews come from Apple Music / iTunes and are used only to point you to the full song on Apple Music.
terms_source_youtube: Trailers play in YouTube’s player and are subject to YouTube’s terms.
terms_source_gemini: The “AI Recommend” button uses Google Gemini to create suggestions.
terms_accuracy_text: Availability, ratings and charts change all the time and may not match what is shown. AI suggestions (including the platforms they name) may be wrong. Please check the provider before subscribing or paying.
terms_account_text: You sign in with your Google account (via Supabase). We keep only what is needed: your Google account details such as your email, and the items you save. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.
terms_ai_text: When you press the AI button, the titles, types, genres and platforms of your saved items are sent to Google Gemini to create suggestions. Your name and email are not sent.
terms_delete_text: You can delete saved items at any time. To delete your account and all data, email {email}.
terms_free_text: This website is free to use — no ads, no subscription fee, and we do not make money from your data.
terms_links_text: When you follow a link to Netflix, Apple Music, YouTube or any other website, that website’s own terms and policies apply.
terms_changes_text: We may update these terms from time to time and will change the “Last updated” date at the top of this page.
